rooms.title: What Connect actually depends on
rooms.why: You cannot debug a contact center if you treat AWS as a logo on the invoice.

rooms.title: Regions, endpoints, and why Osaka is special
rooms.why: A Region is a capacity, latency, and residency boundary. It is not a checkbox you can flip on a live number.

rooms.title: IAM is not the security profile
rooms.why: Agents get a security profile. Automations get an IAM principal. Mixing the names produces a policy that cannot place a call and a user who can.

rooms.title: Lambda is a seam, not a place to hide a CRM
rooms.why: The flow will not wait for a slow system of record. Design the function for the timeout you actually have.

rooms.title: S3 holds the proof
rooms.why: Recordings, chat transcripts, exported reports, and attachments are objects. If the bucket policy is wrong, the contact still 'succeeds' and the file is missing.

rooms.title: Kinesis is how the ecosystem listens
rooms.why: Anything that must react to agents or to finished contacts needs a stream, not a person refreshing a report.

rooms.title: CloudWatch tells you the flow ran
rooms.why: Without flow logs you are guessing which block took the error branch.

rooms.title: The network path is part of the product
rooms.why: Connect's softphone is WebRTC in the agent's browser. A firewall designed for a desk phone will block it.

rooms.title: Certifications and the badges that are not certifications
rooms.why: There is no Amazon Connect specialty exam on the AWS Certification catalog. Pretending a badge is that exam misleads a hiring plan.

rooms.title: A depends-on map you can defend
rooms.why: Every later track names the foundation it needs. If that foundation is missing, the track's lab will show the same fault.

rooms.title: Create the instance on purpose
rooms.why: The instance is the tenancy boundary for users, flows, and numbers. An accidental second instance splits reports and identity.

rooms.title: SAML attributes that make a user real
rooms.why: A successful SAML login that lands without a routing profile is a user who cannot take a contact.

rooms.title: CloudFormation, CDK, and Terraform
rooms.why: Clicking the console does not review. A stack does.

rooms.title: Prompts, statuses, and the small quotas
rooms.why: The limits that surprise people are the ones marked not adjustable.

rooms.title: DID, toll-free, shared cost, UIFN
rooms.why: The number type is a cost and a failure-domain choice.

rooms.title: Claiming and the false 'limit' on the first number
rooms.why: The first claim is a Support conversation more often than people expect.

rooms.title: Porting without losing the rollback
rooms.why: A port is a date with the losing carrier. It is not a flow change.

rooms.title: SIP, external voice, and what is not a trunk in the CUCM sense
rooms.why: Connect does not give you a CUCM SIP trunk page. It gives you native telephony, transfers to numbers, and an external voice connector for analytics.

rooms.title: Outbound calls and caller ID
rooms.why: Outbound is a queue setting, a permission, and a country quota.

rooms.title: Flow types are not one canvas
rooms.why: Each flow type only offers the blocks that make sense there. A hold flow is not a place to transfer to a queue and hope.

rooms.title: The block catalog, grouped by job
rooms.why: You do not memorize fifty icons. You group them by the job they do.

rooms.title: Attributes are the only memory the next system gets
rooms.why: If it is not an attribute, the CRM, the whisper, and the CTR cannot see it.

rooms.title: Modules are how you stop copying flows
rooms.why: A copied inbound flow drifts. A module has one published body.

rooms.title: Every error branch is a product decision
rooms.why: An unconnected error output hangs up. That is a choice, even if you did not mean it.

rooms.title: The flow language is how instances share a design
rooms.why: The designer is a view. The JSON is what you review and promote.

rooms.title: Get customer input is the Lex block
rooms.why: There is no separate 'Lex block' to hunt for. Get customer input is where the bot is selected.

rooms.title: Slots become attributes or they vanish
rooms.why: The agent cannot see a slot you did not copy.

rooms.title: Fallback is a route, not a failure
rooms.why: Callers who say something unexpected are still customers.

rooms.title: Wisdom, Q, and agent assist are one lineage
rooms.why: Using the old name in a design review is fine. Using it as the only name in a 2026 runbook is not.

rooms.title: Turn on assist only where you can show the source
rooms.why: A generated sentence without a cited article is not knowledge. It is a guess in the agent's ear.

rooms.title: Agentic CX is a flow exit, not a magic queue
rooms.why: The application returns an exit condition. Your flow must have a branch for each one, including failure.

rooms.title: Voice ID has ended
rooms.why: On 14 October 2026 this feature is already past its end of support. Leave the blocks out.

rooms.title: The response contract
rooms.why: Connect does not debug your function. It branches.

rooms.title: When the work is slower than eight seconds
rooms.why: Silence is a defect. Async plus a prompt is the pattern.

rooms.title: Association, resource policy, and the log that says AccessDenied
rooms.why: The flow log is telling the truth. The function never ran.

rooms.title: Queues wait. Profiles decide who is eligible.
rooms.why: A queue with nobody whose profile includes it is a silent parking lot.

rooms.title: Priority, delay, and concurrency
rooms.why: Lower priority number wins. Delay keeps a second team in reserve. Concurrency is how many of each channel an agent holds.

rooms.title: Hours and overrides
rooms.why: The check uses the queue's hours and the queue's time zone. Your laptop's clock is irrelevant.

rooms.title: Quick connects and the flows behind them
rooms.why: A quick connect is a target plus a flow. The flow is where you record, whisper, and set attributes.

rooms.title: The CCP is a web app with a telephone inside
rooms.why: Sign-in can succeed when media cannot. Those are different allow lists.

rooms.title: The workspace is where the ecosystem becomes visible
rooms.why: Profiles, cases, views, and third-party apps belong here, not in a second monitor full of URLs.

rooms.title: Streams is the supported way to embed the CCP
rooms.why: If you must hide the CCP inside another app, use amazon-connect-streams. Do not scrape the page.

rooms.title: VDI, VPN, and the audio path
rooms.why: The browser that runs the CCP must be the browser whose network can reach TURN.

rooms.title: Profiles are the customer, not the contact
rooms.why: The contact ends. The profile is how the next contact knows who called.

rooms.title: Cases survive the transfer
rooms.why: A case is the issue. Contacts are the attempts to close it.

rooms.title: Tasks are the channel with no audio
rooms.why: A promise to call back, a form to review, and a follow-up are tasks. They have quotas and an expiry.

rooms.title: One customer, three objects
rooms.why: Profile, case, and contact answer different questions. Collapsing them makes reporting lie.

rooms.title: Chat, SMS, WhatsApp, and the idle-chat quota
rooms.why: A chat that has gone quiet is still an active chat. The default ceiling is 500, shared with SMS, WhatsApp, and Apple Messages for Business.

rooms.title: Email is a contact with a 90-day thread
rooms.why: An email is not a chat transcript and not a case, though it can create both.

rooms.title: Campaigns dial only after the quota is not zero
rooms.why: The default concurrent campaign call quota is 0. The symptom is a fast busy, and it is not a carrier outage.

rooms.title: In-app, web, and video
rooms.why: The customer does not dial. The widget starts a contact. You still pay for voice minutes plus the media type.

rooms.title: Read a CTR before you build a dashboard
rooms.why: The CTR is the finished contact. Real-time metrics are a picture of now. They answer different questions.

rooms.title: Real-time boards and historical intervals
rooms.why: Service level is a historical interval unless you say you are looking at the live queue.

rooms.title: Conversational analytics is Contact Lens under a new name
rooms.why: The function did not vanish on 4 August 2026. The admin guide changed the name.

rooms.title: Agent events are the live staffing truth
rooms.why: The real-time board is a view. The event stream is the feed other systems can trust.

rooms.title: Encryption is a key policy
rooms.why: A customer-managed key you created and then forgot to share with Connect is an outage, not a security win.

rooms.title: SAML, least privilege, and the admin you forgot
rooms.why: Federation does not remove the need for a break-glass admin, and it does not make that admin safe.

rooms.title: Quotas are a project plan
rooms.why: The default numbers in the docs are for new accounts. Your account can be lower because defaults have changed over the years.

rooms.title: How to talk about the price without inventing it
rooms.why: The rate card is public and dated. An estimate that hides the date is a guess.

rooms.title: Only one multi-Region design is supported
rooms.why: AWS says Global Resiliency is the supported multi-Region approach, and that unsupported designs can affect quotas and the SLA story.

rooms.title: What a failover drill has to prove
rooms.why: A drill that only signs an admin in has not tested a customer call.

rooms.title: Migration patterns that survive contact with a Monday
rooms.why: The pattern is dual-run, a small number, evidence, then the rest. Heroic cutovers are how recordings go missing.

rooms.title: Leg, id, counter, capture
rooms.why: The same four questions work on a CUCM trunk and on a Connect flow.

rooms.title: Audio quality is a path, not a codec myth
rooms.why: Connect's softphone does not ask you to pick G.711. The failures are path failures.

rooms.title: A flow log you can actually search
rooms.why: The query is short. The discipline is saving the ContactId before you hang up the test phone.

rooms.title: Faults worth memorizing
rooms.why: A short list beats a wiki nobody opens during an incident.

rooms.title: The mapping table you put in the migration pack
rooms.why: Names from the old platform are not Connect resources. Write the map before you build the queues.

rooms.title: A migration playbook
rooms.why: The order is identity, network, flows, a pilot number, reports, then the port.

rooms.title: Pitfalls that show up in every platform
rooms.why: The platforms differ. The mistakes repeat.

rooms.title: CUIC and the Connect report are different clocks
rooms.why: If you do not write both formulas, the business will say the new platform is slower or faster than it is.

rooms.title: Salesforce: CTI Adapter and SCC-AC
rooms.why: Voice stays on Connect. The question is which system owns the digital channels and the case.

rooms.title: ServiceNow Voice
rooms.why: ServiceNow can own assignment while Connect owns the conversation, if you map the queues on purpose.

rooms.title: Teams is a chat client in the published pattern
rooms.why: The AWS blog's Teams integration is not a SIP trunk into Teams Phone.

rooms.title: CUCM and Webex beside Connect
rooms.why: There is no AWS-managed CUCM CTI adapter in the docs this campus cites. The seam is the phone number.

rooms.title: The contact center is not the whole operation
rooms.why: WFM, quality, emergency location, and the CRM fail quietly when they are bolted on after go-live.

rooms.title: Glossary
rooms.why: A migration argument is usually two definitions of the same word.

rooms.title: Mind map
rooms.why: If you cannot point at the box that owns a function, you will build it twice.

rooms.title: Native forecasting and scheduling
rooms.why: Native WFM is in the product. Third-party WFM is justified when you already live in that suite, not because Connect 'cannot schedule'.

rooms.title: Third-party WFM configuration and faults
rooms.why: The integration is the agent event stream plus a historical extract. If either is late, adherence is fiction.

rooms.title: Recording and screen capture
rooms.why: If the object is not in S3, you do not have a recording, no matter what the flow block said.

rooms.title: Third-party recorders and live media
rooms.why: Some QM suites want the audio while the call is up. That is Kinesis Video Streams, not a second SIP trunk.

rooms.title: Quality management on top of analytics
rooms.why: A score without the recording is an opinion. A recording without a form is an archive.

rooms.title: Configure conversational analytics and fix the empty transcript
rooms.why: Analytics that is not enabled on the contact produces an empty search and a false 'the feature is down'.

rooms.title: E911 for agents on the CCP
rooms.why: A contact-center platform is not automatically an emergency-calling design. In the US Regions where this exists, you still have to store a real address.

rooms.title: CRM configuration and the faults that look like routing bugs
rooms.why: A wrong screen pop is often an attribute bug, not a Salesforce bug.

rooms.title: AI agents: configure, cite, and a way out
rooms.why: An agent who cannot reach a person is not assisted. They are stuck.

rooms.title: Integration maps
rooms.why: A map is a list of seams with a key on each line. A poster of logos is not a map.

rooms.title: Future hooks, not future rewrites
rooms.why: Add the next system on a hook that already exists. Do not scrape the CCP and do not fork the flow for every vendor.

rooms.title: Feature timeline
rooms.why: Names moved. Features mostly stayed. Voice ID did not.
